sources.quote: TrES-1b is an extrasolar planet approximately 523 light-years away in the constellation of Lyra.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TrES-1. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: The planet's mass and radius indicate that it is a Jovian planet with a similar bulk composition to Jupiter.
